The whole team was professional and attentive, and the follow up after my treatment to check in on how I was doing was a really nice touch. It showed they actually care about their patients beyond the appointment itself.

As for the price, let's just say I paid about a third of what I would have spent back in the States. That is not a typo. Same quality of care, significantly friendlier to my wallet.
